WO
Work Order: an order for services from a vendor. Older screens and ids call it a Service Request (SR).
GST-off WO
A Work Order whose vendor charges no GST. Only these can have generated invoices.
Generated invoice
An invoice the app prints for a GST-off WO's vendor to sign (Generate Invoice). Statuses: Generated, Signed, Approved, Voided.
Signed copy
The vendor's signed scan of a generated invoice, uploaded with Upload signed copy, or with Add Invoice when the AI reads its number.
Vendor Invoice
The invoice record Accountants approve. Pending until approved by an invoice approver or by the System.
Invoice approver
Admin, Accountant or Accountant Lead: the people who may approve or reject an invoice by hand.
System
The app's own decision. An invoice it approves shows Approved by System and auto_approved 1.
Rule 1 / 2 / 3
ADR-0050's rules: 1 a generated invoice's signed copy; 2 Approved invoices + this one = the WO total; 3 = the WO's Amount Paid incl. TDS. Each within ₹1.
Not Auto-Approved Reason
The column on Pending Invoice Approvals that says why the System left an invoice Pending.
not_procurement_order
Before this branch, the one reason every WO invoice got: auto-approval was for Purchase Orders only.
Re-check
A button on Pending Invoice Approvals that runs the auto-approval check again now, showing a preview before anything is approved.
Amount Paid
What has been paid to the WO's vendor, including TDS held back.
TDS
Tax deducted at source: tax the company holds back from a vendor payment and pays to the tax office for the vendor. It counts in Amount Paid.
GST-on WO
A Work Order whose vendor charges GST. Rule 3 compares its base parts only: base paid (GST payments left out) against base invoiced.
Near miss
An invoice the walk adds ₹50 away from the matching amount, to show that ₹1 is the limit.
Typed amount
An invoice whose number and amounts the person types because the AI read nothing. AI-filled fields are shaded amber; typed ones are not.
Invoice check
On a WO, a new payment request waits while money raised exceeds Approved invoices by ₹100 or more (#1488). Request Payment shows Raised and Approved invoices.
Generate range
The amounts Generate Invoice allows: at least what is paid (incl. TDS) but not invoiced yet, at most what is left of the WO amount.
FINAL
The last generated invoice of a WO: it bills what is left of the WO's total.
AI read
Document AI reads an uploaded invoice's number, amount and, for a generated invoice's copy, its signature box. The test envs have no AI key, so the walk answers that call itself.
Before / After
Before is GitHub develop at 91bb9c3dd. After is the branch wo/inv-auto (the commit walked is in the header). Both run on copies of the same backup.

How serious a pinned point is: must fix before merge, should fix, small polish, or just worth knowing.
